summary: Complex patching can be a controller workflow: sync project and inventory in parallel, snapshot each host (ticket on failure), patch (on failure restore the snapshot and open a ticket), then delete snapshots of hosts that patched successfully.
questions: How do I snapshot VMs before patching with AAP?
Workflow example for patching with rollback
Can AAP open a ticket when patching fails?

answer_card.title: Patching workflow with snapshots and rollback
answer_card.answer_md:
Chain jobs in an automation controller **workflow**:

1. Project sync and inventory sync (in parallel)
2. Snapshot each target host. On failure: submit a ticket
3. Patch each host. On failure: restore the snapshot and submit a ticket
4. On success: delete the snapshot
